subject: Data retention exception request - Acme Health (follow-up)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Smith <julia.smith@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Data retention exception request - Acme Health (follow-up)

Hi Julia,

Thanks again for taking the time today - great to learn more about Acme Health's use case for HIPAA-protected clinical summaries. Per our call, I wanted to capture the items we discussed and proposed next steps around data retention and logging controls.

Summary of ask:
- Acme requests a 0-retention option for any request/response content that contains patient PII (no persisted request/response logs).
- Where logs are required for debugging, retention must be limited to 7 days and redacted for PII before storage.
- Data residency: customer-managed VPC deployment in us-west-2 (dedicated/private) with keys in Acme's KMS.
- Audit logging: access logs must be retained for 365 days and made available on request.

Immediate next steps I proposed:
1) I will loop in our Solutions and Legal teams (cc'ed) to validate feasibility and provide a draft exception SOW.
2) We will provide a short technical design for the redaction + 0-retention flow and an engineering ETA.
3) Acme to confirm the list of API surfaces and environments that must be subject to 0-retention (prod only vs prod+staging).

Marissa / Rafael - can you confirm feasibility for a 0-retention toggle per-customer, the redaction pipeline, and whether we can provide a 7-day debug-log window with PII redaction? Also flag any compliance/contract language we should propose.

Julia - expect a draft SOW and technical note from us by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Julia Smith <julia.smith@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Health Security <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data retention exception request - Acme Health (follow-up)

Hi Camila -

Appreciate the follow-up and summary. Correct on all points. A couple clarifications from our security and compliance team:

- 0-retention must be the default for any endpoint that can receive or return PHI/PII. We can permit ephemeral debug logs only via a signed exception that auto-expires after 7 days.
- Redaction must remove direct identifiers (name, SSN, medical record numbers) before any content is captured for debugging. If automated redaction fails, logs must not be persisted.
- Data residency: we require the full inference flow (request handling, KV cache, and any temp storage) to remain in us-west-2. Customer-managed KMS is mandatory.

We are comfortable with a signed SOW for an exception as long as the technical controls and validation steps are included. Please include acceptance criteria for how redaction is verified (e.g., sample audit run, redaction tests).

Thanks -
Julia Smith
Director of IT Security, Acme Health
julia.smith@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Julia Smith <julia.smith@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data retention exception request - Acme Health (follow-up)

Hi Julia / Camila -

Quick technical readout after a brief sync with infra/engineering:

Feasibility notes:
- 0-retention mode: feasible. We can implement a per-customer toggle that bypasses persistent request/response storage. This requires a dedicated routing policy and configuration at the serving layer.
- Debug logs: we can enable ephemeral debug logs that are written to an encrypted short-lived store with automated deletion after 7 days. We'll run automated redaction before writing. If redaction confidence is below threshold, logs are discarded.
- KV cache residency: we can pin KV cache to us-west-2 and prevent offsite spillover for the dedicated/private deployment.

Questions / impact:
- There is a ~3 week engineering effort to build the per-customer toggle and the redaction confidence checks for production. We can accelerate to 2 weeks with a scope-limited ship (toggle + basic redaction; extended redaction enumerations in follow-up).
- We need to confirm whether Acme expects the toggle to be available for both Hosted Dedicated and Private. Private already meets residency/KMS requirements; Dedicated will need configuration.

I'll draft a short technical note that we can include in the SOW with acceptance criteria and a test plan (sample redaction tests + audit run).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Smith <julia.smith@acmehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data retention exception request - Acme Health (follow-up)

Hi all -

Thanks for the detail. From a legal/compliance perspective we can support a data retention exception via SOW amendment. A few contract items to include:

1) Scope: define exact API surfaces, environments, and the toggle semantics (prod-only toggle vs. all environments).
2) Controls: description of automated redaction, retention windows (7 days for debug logs), and conditions that cause logs to be discarded.
3) Verification: quarterly redaction test reports for the first 12 months and ad-hoc audit rights (with agreed notification window).
4) Security: confirmation that keys are customer-managed (KMS) and that logs remain in us-west-2.
5) Liability & indemnity: limited carveouts for breaches caused by customer-provided content where redaction cannot be reasonably performed; otherwise, standard liability caps apply.

I will attach a standard "data-retention-exception" template for SOW language and propose the following path:
- Camila to send a draft SOW that incorporates Marissa's technical note and the template I attach.
- Acme signs the exception SOW and we schedule an engineering kickoff.

Attaching template now. Rafael
